wa_big_craggy_peak_scramble.note: SummitPost The Craggies (https://www.summitpost.org/the-craggies/153369) states gain 4,500 ft car to Big Craggy summit via the SE shoulder from the Copper Glance trail. One source and >10% from stored 5600, so not set. The Mountaineers page covers both Craggies.

wa_mount_larrabee_south_ridge.note: Mountaineers mount-larrabee (https://www.mountaineers.org/activities/routes-places/mount-larrabee) states 2,600 ft from Twin Lakes (stored trailhead ~5,200 ft matches Twin Lakes) and 4,400 ft from the Tomyhoi Lake trailhead. One source and >10% from stored 3900, so not set. SummitPost mount-larrabee/151373 states no gain.

wa_silver_star_glacier.note: Mountaineers silver-star-mountain-silver-star-glacier (https://www.mountaineers.org/activities/routes-places/silver-star-mountain-silver-star-glacier) lists elevation gain 5,200 ft; Abegg states 4,626 ft car to summit. They differ by >10%, so no lock; both say stored 4000 is low. SummitPost Burgundy Col route page (158024) states no gain.

wa_cutthroat_south_buttress.note: Mountaineers cutthroat-peak-se-buttress (https://www.mountaineers.org/activities/routes-places/cutthroat-peak-se-buttress), Grade III 5.8 (appears to be this route), lists elevation gain 3,050 ft. One source and >10% from stored 2500, so not set. SummitPost south-buttress/156884 and francisbaileyh.com (958 m, metres only) give no usable second figure.
